caption: The drawing features a scene with a two-story house positioned near the center, rendered in shades of beige, brown, and muted yellow. The house has a gabled roof and several rectangular windows. To the left of the house, there is a large rock formation with foliage, and behind this, leafy trees and a tall plant are visible. Several more trees, with broad, rounded canopies, fill the background on both sides of the composition; these trees are depicted in mixtures of brown and yellow tones. To the right of the house, there is a human figure walking, dressed in light brown clothing and holding a stick or cane. The ground is illustrated in similar beige, brown, and yellow hues, with paths, grassy patches, and additional shrubs. The sky is a solid yellow, and the entire scene is framed by a plain beige border.
title: Wallpaper Used as Bandbox Covering
